cohort: The study included 6763 pregnant women (1743 advanced maternal age and 5020 younger women) beyond 28 weeks of gestation, both primiparous and multiparous, from three academic teaching hospitals in West Java, Indonesia.
finding: Advanced maternal age pregnancies were significantly associated with a higher incidence of antepartum hemorrhage (OR=1.94), hypertensive pregnancy (OR=1.90), and intrauterine fetal death (OR=1.49).
